comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/drawing-flat-pattern-view.mitcad-ui (mitcad#2280): the L of tools/cli/tests/sheet_flat_dxf.json without its hole (sheet rules F1: t = 2, r = 3, K = 0.3; a 35 x 20 Face F3 at x = -30..5; a 90 degree Flange F4 on its edge at x = 5, tangent length 15, inside), its body named Plate (F3.b0), and an empty Drawing1 (D1, A3). Its Flat Pattern seen from the front is 50.654866776461628 x 20 with a down bend's centre line at x = 2.827433388230814: placed at 1:1 with its middle at (150, 150) on the sheet, the bend line runs at x = 157.5 from y = 140 to 160 and the blank ends at x = 175.33. All geometry is synthetic.
